title: 🏡✨ Curb Appeal Matters! ✨🏡
description:
Did you know that 77% of buyer agents say staging helps buyers visualize themselves in a home? First impressions start before they even step inside! 👀

✅ Power wash your driveway, sidewalk, and home—clean = inviting!
✅ Check your front door—peeling paint, cobwebs, or outdated décor can be a turnoff.
✅ Work with your agent to stage your home for that WOW factor!

Small touches = BIG impact when selling your home! 🏡💰 Ready to maximize your home’s value? Let’s chat! 📩
